headline: HuyenBao v11.11 — Kinh Dịch (I Ching) integrated from Huyen-Hoc-AI
summary: First Huyen-Hoc-AI feature brought into the main app: a full Kinh Dịch (I Ching) oracle in the Spirit tab. The deterministic coin-cast (3 coins × 6 lines → King Wen hexagram → moving lines → transformed hexagram) is ported from the Huyen-Hoc-AI FastAPI backend to TypeScript and runs client-side. A new /api/divine endpoint interprets the cast through the app's existing local LLM (Ollama, same client as /api/story) with a Kinh Dịch-specific prompt, falling back to ZAI cloud then to a deterministic local reading — so the oracle always returns a result. The interpretation is written in the player's UI language (EN/VI/中文). All 64 hexagram names use the canonical Sino-Vietnamese / Wilhelm-English / original-Chinese set. The feature needs no save-state change and has no runtime dependency on the FastAPI service, so it works the moment the app is deployed.
features: New Kinh Dịch panel in the Spirit tab: question input + cast button → primary hexagram, hào lines (yang/yin, moving highlighted), moving-lines list, changed hexagram (quẻ biến) when there are moving lines, verdict badge (Cát/Hung/Tĩnh), LLM interpretation + reflection
src/lib/iching.ts: full deterministic engine — 8 trigrams, King Wen 8×8 table, 64 hexagrams (VI/EN/ZH names + themes), crypto-fair 3-coin cast, hào động detection, quẻ biến computation

POST /api/divine: LLM interpretation via the existing Ollama connection (LLM_BASE_URL), ZAI cloud fallback, deterministic local-reading fallback — always returns a valid reading in the player's language
Client-side 8s throttle prevents spam-casting (no save-state change, no engine change)
Disclaimer note (disc.aiNote) shown under every reading: AI prophecies & events are fictional — entertainment only
Version bumped to v11.11 on homepage header + version.json
